name: Lara Herrmann
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Seattle, Washington
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Aviation & Aerospace, Civil Rights
about: Lara Herrmann, a third-generation trial lawyer, is the co-owner and CEO of Herrmann Law Group, with offices in Seattle and Tacoma, Washington. A passionate advocate of the rights of her clients from across the world, she assists victims of aviation disasters, wrongful deaths, civil rights cases, medical malpractice cases and other personal injury cases in obtaining the compensation they need to restart their lives.

Known for her honesty and compassion, Ms. Herrmann has secured millions of dollars for injured and deceased victims of some of the world’s worst mass-casualty disasters, including China Airlines Flight 611’s midair explosion, Air China Flight 129’s crash in Korea and Asiana Airlines Flight 214’s crash landing in San Francisco. Professional and aggressive, she lifts the weight of the world from her clients’ shoulders and enables them to focus on healing from the accident.

Driven by her family values, Ms. Herrmann has represented people injured by a train derailing and vaping victims throughout her career spanning 20-plus years. A 1995 graduate of Washington State University, she went to Seattle University School of Law to acquire her Juris Doctor in 2000. She holds an active license to practice in the state of Washington.

An EAGLE member of the Washington State Association for Justice, Ms. Herrmann taught trial skills at the Trial Advocacy Program for the Louisiana State University Paul M. Hebert Law Center. She is significantly involved in several organizations such as the American Immigration Lawyers Association, the Washington State Bar Association, the King County Bar Association, the Tacoma-Pierce County Bar Association and the Washington Women Lawyers.

Ms. Herrmann has been highlighted among the Top 100 trial attorneys in the U.S. and the Top 10 aviation trial lawyers by The National Trial Lawyers. She has been listed in the top 500 consumer lawyers by Lawdragon magazine. She created the Seattle University School of Law Woman of the Year Award to honor outstanding women in the legal field. She has been a featured speaker at the International Symposium on Aviation Accident Law to her deep knowledge of aviation.
